newsitem.title: INDIA: Reliance drives up Delhi stocks.
newsitem.headline: Reliance drives up Delhi stocks.

text.p: Delhi stocks climbed in early trade on Friday on news that Reliance Industries will consider a bonus issue on June 26 and better than expected results of State Bank of India, brokers said.
After 30 minutes of trading, the Delhi Stock Exchange Benchmark Index was up 3.93 points at 865.04.
"A fresh spell of buying was fuelled by expectations that Reliance would recommend an attractive ratio for bonus shares," said Shree Bhagwan Garg of stock brokerage Mean Leasing Pvt Ltd.
Traders said that foreign institutional investors and domestic investors made sizeable purchases in multinationals and and firms with strong fundamentals.

State Bank of India, which announced a 60 percent increase in net profit on Thursday, gained 4.40 rupees to 328. The bank's net profit rose to 13.29 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) from 8.31 billion in 1996/96.
Nestle India rose nine rupees to 298.
Hindustan Lever climbed three rupees to 1,368.
